overall_goal: Grease a pan with olive oil and turn on the heat

goals.description: Pour olive oil into a cup
goals.rationale: The person opens the olive oil bottle and repeatedly pours spoonfuls of oil into a metallic cup.

goals.description: Grease the pan with olive oil using a spoon
goals.rationale: The person scoops oil from the cup and spreads it on the pan using a spoon.

goals.description: Prepare a basting brush and spread oil on the pan
goals.rationale: The person retrieves, washes, and dries a basting brush, then uses it to further spread the oil on the pan.

goals.description: Add more oil to the pan and turn on the heat
goals.rationale: The person adds more oil to the pan, spreads it, and turns on the electric hob to heat the pan.
